'''Javier Pérez-Ramírez''' (born 28 October 1974) is a Professor of [[Catalysis]] and [[Chemical Engineering]] at [[ETH Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.chab.ethz.ch/en/research/institutes/ICB/people/professors.html|title = ICB Professors|publisher = ETH Zurich|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref>

== Career ==
Javier Pérez-Ramírez (JPR) studied [[Chemical engineering|Chemical Engineering]] at the University of Alicante, and later obtained his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] [[Latin honors|cum laude]] at [[Delft University of Technology|TU Delft]] (2002). He worked for [[Norsk Hydro]] and [[Yara International]] and returned to academia as an [[Catalan Institution for Research and Advanced Studies|ICREA]] research professor at the Institute of Chemical Research of Catalonia, related to the [[Rovira i Virgili University]] (2005-2009). Since 2010, he is [[Professor|Full Professor]] of Catalysis Engineering at the Institute for Chemical and Bioengineering at the
[[ETH Zurich|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich]].<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.chab.ethz.ch/en/research/institutes/ICB/people/professors.html|title = ICB Professors|publisher = ETH Zurich|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref> In 2018 he became visiting professor and director of the [http://greenenergy.nus.edu.sg/profile/profile/58.html Flagship Green Energy Program] at the [http://nus.edu.sg/ National University of Singapore].

He is Editorial Board Chair of ''[[Green Chemistry (journal)|Green Chemistry]]'',<ref>{{cite web|url=https://blogs.rsc.org/gc/2023/01/18/eic-javier-perez-ramirez/|title=Welcome Javier Pérez-Ramírez, our new Editorial Board Chair|publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry|date=18 January 2023|accessdate=19 January 2023}}</ref> and sits on the editorial board of ''[[Advanced Functional Materials]]'', ''[https://www.sciencedirect.com/applied-catalysis-b-environmental/ Applied Catalysis B: Environmental]'', ''[[ACS Catalysis]]'', ''[[Energy Technology (journal)|Energy Technology]]'', and ''[https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/catalysis-communications/ Catalysis Communications]''.

Since 2018, Pérez-Ramírez is president of the [https://scg.ch/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=654&Itemid=1139&lang=en Catalysis Section] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181209124134/https://scg.ch/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=654&Itemid=1139&lang=en |date=2018-12-09 }} of the Swiss Chemical Society. He is Swiss representative of the [https://efcats.org/About+us.html European Federation of Catalysis]. Since 2020, he directs [https://nccr-catalysis.ch/ NCCR Catalysis], a national center of competence in research funded by the [https://www.snf.ch/en Swiss National Science Foundation].

==Research==
Pérez-Ramírez's central research focuses on the fundamental design and technical development of new [[heterogeneous catalysts]] and [[reactor engineering]] concepts, favoring the more efficient and [[Sustainable development|sustainable]] manufacturing within the [[chemical industry]].<ref>{{Cite web|title = News {{!}} IOM3|url = http://www.iom3.org/news/2015/mar/30/beilby-medal-and-prize-awarded-professor-javier-p%25C3%25A9rezram%25C3%25ADrez|website = www.iom3.org|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref> He has developed novel catalysts for the gas-phase [[Catalytic oxidation|oxidation]] of [[hydrogen chloride]] ([[Deacon process]])<ref>{{Cite web|title = DECHEMA Awards for Catalysis :: ChemViews Magazine :: ChemistryViews|url = http://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/2113771/DECHEMA_Awards_for_Catalysis.html|website = www.chemistryviews.org| date=6 July 2012 |accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref> and has done major and groundbreaking contributions in the rational design of hierarchical [[zeolite]]s.<ref>{{Cite web|title = EFCATS - European Federation of Catalysis Societies|url = http://www.efcats.org/Awards-p-75.html|website = www.efcats.org|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref>

==Awards==
Pérez-Ramírez's work of nearly 480 articles and 17 patents has been recognized by several major prizes, including the Paul H. Emmett Award in Fundamental Catalysis (2019),<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://nacatsoc.org/award/javier-perez-ramirez-is-the-recipient-of-the-2019-paul-h-emmett-award-in-fundamental-catalysis/|title=Javier Pérez-Ramírez is the recipient of the 2019 Paul H. Emmett Award in Fundamental Catalysis|date=13 November 2018|website=North American Catalysis Society|language=en-US|access-date=8 December 2018}}</ref> Xingda Lecturship of Peking University (2018),<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chab.ethz.ch/en/news-and-events/d-chab-news/2018/06/prof-perez-ramirez-honored-with-the-xingda-lectureship-2018.html|title=Prof. Pérez-Ramírez honored with the Xingda Lectureship 2018|website=www.chab.ethz.ch|date=11 June 2018 |language=en|access-date=8 December 2018}}</ref> Sustainable Energy Award (2017),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/SustainableEnergyAward/2017-Winner.asp|title=Sustainable Energy Award 2017 Winner|publisher=Royal Society of Chemistry|accessdate=8 June 2017}}</ref> the [[Beilby Medal and Prize]] (2014),<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.soci.org/News/Awards/Other/Beilby-Perez-Ramirez|title=2014 Beilby Medal and Prize awarded to Prof Javier Pérez-Ramírez|publisher=Society of Chemical Industry|accessdate=9 October 2015}}</ref> the EFCATS Young Researcher Award (2013),<ref>{{Cite web|title = EFCATS - European Federation of Catalysis Societies|url = http://www.efcats.org/Awards-p-75.html|website = www.efcats.org|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref> the DECHEMA Otto Roelen Medal (2012),<ref>{{Cite web|title = DECHEMA {{!}} Gesellschaft für Chemische Technik und Biotechnologie e.V.|url = http://dechema.de/en/Otto+Roelen+Medal.html|website = dechema.de|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title = Javier Pérez-Ramírez Awarded Otto Roelen Medal 2012|url = http://www.materialsviews.com/javier-perez-ramirez-awarded-otto-roelen-medal-2012/|website = MaterialsViews|accessdate = 12 November 2015|language = en-US}}</ref> the Andrew Main lectureship (2013),<ref>{{Cite web|title = DB Robinson Speaker Dr Javier Perez-Ramirez does some treasure hunting in catalysis - Department of Chemical & Materials Engineering - University of Alberta|url = http://www.cme.engineering.ualberta.ca/NewsEvents/CMENews/2013/February/DBRobinsonSpeakerDrJavierPerez-Ramirezdoessometreasurehuntingincatalysis.aspx|website = www.cme.engineering.ualberta.ca|accessdate = 12 November 2015}}{{Dead link|date=March 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> the UOP-Honeywell Invitational Lectureship (2012),<ref>{{Cite web|title = Prof. Javier Pérez-Ramírez -
